name: Oryx Desert Salt
description:
Oryx Desert Salt has a unique origin tale, beginning in the Kalahari Desert. When Samantha Skyring, founder & CEO, walked 7 days / 120 km / 75 miles through the Namib Desert in July 2000, having close encounters with the Oryx, she had no idea this would influence the creation of the global brand, Oryx Desert Salt.

The Oryx truly honours the heritage of Oryx Desert Salt. Harvested sustainably from the vast Kalahari Desert in Southern Africa, our salt comes from an ancient underground lake fed by subterranean streams flowing through 250-million-year-old Dwyka rock strata, then laid on a natural pan under the hot African sun. 100% sun-dried, unrefined & unprocessed, it contains the perfect natural balance of minerals and trace elements, allowing the body to absorb and utilise for optimal functioning, vitality, and health.
